notes.title: My Big Sister: Remastered now in Ukrainian! + Save corrupt fix
notes.content:
MY BIG SISTER IS NOW IN UKRAINIAN! 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43088805/6fa5ecaf642ed3f59facba661a4b51bc963a9b89.png

I would like to personally thank  [ASTRO], Chiliyskiy, MegaMix_Craft and R.Order for volunteering their time and effort to translate My Big Sister: Remastered to Ukrainian. 

As well I have included a small patch alongside it:

    Fixed a small bug where the bathhouse background music was not looping once returning. 


Things currently being worked on: 

    French translation (afaik)


Warning: Updating could result in possible corrupted save files, here's how to fix them!

To fix the save file issue, you will have to revert to a previous update. To do this; right click the game in your Steam library and go to properties, under the beta tab select the dropdown box and select a rollback version (rollbackver0.1 to be precise) until your save files work again

https://i.imgur.com/lOkwsJz.png

notes.title: My Big Sister: Remastered now in Russian!
notes.content:
MY BIG SISTER IS NOW IN RUSSIAN! 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43088805/6fa5ecaf642ed3f59facba661a4b51bc963a9b89.png

I would like to personally thank MegaMix_Craft and R.Order for volunteering their time and efforts to translate My Big Sister: Remastered to Russian. 

As well I have included a small patch alongside it:

    Fixed Noodle Lady being interactable in the last chapter in the living room after "certain" events 
    Fixed Therapist's face appearing in the textbox when interacting with the brain.  
    Fixed The Butcher repeating dialogue about the knife once acquired it. 
    Fixed Sombria's interaction in the engine room of the train when she's not there. 
    Fixed various smaller bugs.

notes.title: It's translations time!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are in need of volunteer translators/proofreaders/editors to assist us in bringing My Big Sister: Remastered into your native language!
If you wish to contribute - you can find detailed instructions on our Github Repository and collaborate with others on our Discord server.
We have both bare files to translate from scratch and auto-generated translations which some may find useful for editing/proofreading purposes. 

Any and all contributions are greatly appreciated and will be added to the game's credits accordingly!
We look forward to working with you! :heart:

- MegaMix_Craft & Stranga
